_doc: Configured primary-source feeds for the weekly Policy Map milestone scan. SEARCH-FIRST: in the scheduled-run sandbox, web_fetch only accepts URLs that a prior WebSearch (or the task prompt) surfaced — so the scan must run each feed's `search` queries FIRST, then web_fetch only the specific press-release URLs those searches return. Do NOT try to fetch the index/news pages cold. Japanese-first: read the Japanese source, author in Japanese, then translate to English. Map each item to one domain + one subtheme id from policymap_data.json.
fetch_policy: search-first: WebSearch each query, then web_fetch only result URLs from the body's official domain. Prefer RSS where listed.
